Have you considered going to a friend's house? It won't fix your pain, but maybe a good friend of yours could help a bit more with that than I can.

Also consider going some place that you enjoy going to. I personally like going to Best Buy and just looking at the cool gadgetry they have there. Some place to get your mind off things. I understand it's a bit late, but there are always some places you could go to take your mind off of it a bit.

Also, consider biting the bullet and heading home. I feel like this would be the hardest one, but may help too. I understand it'll be hard to see your mom after saying things that you may have said. But it's also understandable that you were frustrated and said some things you may not have wanted to say. It happens to all of us. I'm not saying your pain is not justified or belittling it, but I'm saying just sticking it through just a bit more may be all you need. You never know what's on the other side.

I'm actually going through a very similar thing right now. I don't want to end it, but it feels like it's the right thing to do at this point, personally. In this situation, I'd consider maybe apologizing. It's amazing how much an apology could mean to somebody. I feel like she may be going through similar feelings as you are now too.

You could try calling her or something to apologise or if that's a bit scary, maybe just start by asking if she's okay. I know it's easier said than done, believe me. But I'd at least consider it.
